translations.web: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am Yahweh your God.’ ”
translations.bsb: You are to have the same standard of law for the foreign resident and the native; for I am the LORD your God.’”
translations.kjv: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the LORD your God.
translations.asv: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the sojourner, as for the home-born: for I am Jehovah your God.
